module.purpose: Defines the collaborative presence record schema, runtime validation, migration history, and record-type factory for tldraw multiplayer sessions.
module.summary: This module models ephemeral per-user collaboration state, including identity, cursor, camera, selection, brush, scribbles, chat, metadata, and page context. It exposes a runtime validator, ordered schema migrations for backward and forward compatibility, and a presence-scoped record type with defaults for nullable and collection fields. Migration steps mutate legacy records in place and provide downgrade normalization for fields introduced as nullable.
module.businessContext: Supports real-time collaboration by representing what users are doing in a shared tldraw document. Failures can prevent presence data from validating, migrating, or displaying correctly for collaborators.

publicSignatures.name: TLInstancePresence
publicSignatures.signature: export interface TLInstancePresence extends BaseRecord<'instance_presence', TLInstancePresenceID> {

typeShapes.name: TLInstancePresence
typeShapes.shape:
{
	userId: TLUserId
	userName: string
	lastActivityTimestamp: number | null
	color: string // can be any hex color
	camera: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null
	selectedShapeIds: TLShapeId[]
	currentPageId: TLPageId
	brush: BoxModel | null
	scribbles: TLScribble[]
	screenBounds: BoxModel | null
	followingUserId: TLUserId | null
	cursor: {
		x: number
		y: number
		type: TLCursor['type']
		rotation: number
	} | null
	chatMessage: string
	meta: JsonObject
}

edgeCases.inputShape: null camera, cursor, screenBounds, or lastActivityTimestamp during downgrade
edgeCases.behavior: Each null value is replaced with a concrete legacy-compatible default.
The scribble delay is initialized to zero when the scribble is non-null.
The obsolete instanceId property is deleted.

edgeCases.inputShape: record from before chat or metadata fields existed
edgeCases.behavior: Missing chatMessage becomes an empty string and missing meta becomes an empty object.
The runtime validator rejects values that do not match the declared model.

boundaryConditions.intent: Only initialize delay when the legacy scribble exists.
Restore a legacy camera when the downgraded value is null.
Restore zero activity time when the downgraded value is null.
Restore a default cursor when the downgraded value is null.
Restore default screen bounds when the downgraded value is null.

invariants.description: Validated records use the instance_presence typeName and matching instance_presence identifier prefix.
Presence records always contain user identity, page identity, chat text, metadata, and collection fields.
Migration transformations execute in the declared sequence order.
Downgraded records receive concrete camera, activity timestamp, cursor, and screen bounds when nullable values are absent.

assumptions.description: Migration inputs are mutable record-like objects whose legacy properties can be assigned or deleted.
Imported validators and record helpers enforce the intended identifier and nested geometry schemas.

ambiguities.question: What historical record shape contains instance.scribble and its delay property?
Why is RenameSelectedShapeIds intentionally a no-op despite its migration name?

concurrencyModel.notes: Validation, default construction, and migration callbacks are synchronous; no asynchronous or shared scheduling is introduced.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A complete instance presence record is accepted by the runtime validator.
given: const presence = { typeName: 'instance_presence', id: 'instance_presence:user1', userId: 'user1', userName: 'John', color: '#007AFF', lastActivityTimestamp: null, followingUserId: null, cursor: null, camera: null, screenBounds: null, selectedShapeIds: [], currentPageId: 'page:main', brush: null, scribbles: [], chatMessage: '', meta: {} }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the complete wire shape and required instance_presence discriminator.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Creating a presence record without optional activity fields supplies the declared defaults.
given: const input = { id: 'instance_presence:user1', userId: 'user1', userName: 'Alice', currentPageId: 'page:main' }
moduleContractTests.then: the result has color '#FF0000', camera null, cursor null, selectedShapeIds [], scribbles [], chatMessage '', and meta {}
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards stable defaults for newly created ephemeral presence records.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Downgrading a record with nullable camera, activity timestamp, cursor, or screen bounds restores legacy values.
given: const record = { camera: null, lastActivityTimestamp: null, cursor: null, screenBounds: null }
moduleContractTests.then: record.camera equals { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 }, record.lastActivityTimestamp equals 0, record.cursor equals { type: 'default', x: 0, y: 0, rotation: 0 }, and record.screenBounds equals { x: 0, y: 0, w: 1, h: 1 }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins backward compatibility behavior for the NullableCameraCursor migration.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Migrating an older presence record through the AddMeta version initializes missing metadata.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards schema evolution for the required meta object.

detail.summary: Defines the public types, validator, migration sequence, and record type for ephemeral collaborative instance-presence records. The module guarantees a consistent schema and record identity for presence state such as cursor, camera, selection, and collaboration metadata.

detail.name: up
detail.summary: Applies the first upward migration for instance-presence records, transforming a record from its prior schema version to the next supported version.

detail.name: up
preconditions: The instance argument is available to the migration callback.
postconditions: If instance.scribble is not null, instance.scribble.delay equals 0.
If instance.scribble is null, the instance remains unchanged.
invariants: The migration does not create scribble data when it is null.
Only the scribble delay field is changed by the observed operation.
edgeCases: When instance.scribble is null, no mutation is performed.
When instance.scribble is non-null, its delay is set to 0 regardless of its prior value.
detail.summary: Updates an instance migration record by resetting the scribble delay to zero when scribble data is present. Instances without scribble data are left unchanged.

specLiterals.role: The migration resets the scribble delay to this value.

specTests.then: The same scribble object has delay equal to 0.
The instance remains unchanged and no scribble object is created.

detail.name: up
preconditions: instance is an object whose properties may be modified.
postconditions: instance no longer has its own instanceId property.
invariants: No properties other than instanceId are changed.
edgeCases: If instanceId is absent, the operation is a no-op.
If instanceId is present, it is deleted from the instance.
If instance is null or undefined, property deletion fails with the runtime TypeError produced by JavaScript.

raises: TypeError when the supplied value cannot be used as an object, such as null or undefined.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: The runtime property-deletion error is propagated.

detail.summary: Migrates an instance presence record by removing its legacy instanceId property.

specTests.then: instanceId is absent afterward and the unrelated property remains unchanged.
The object remains unchanged and the function returns undefined.

units.name: down

detail.name: down
preconditions: record is a mutable instance-presence record object.
postconditions: record.camera is replaced with the default camera when it is null.
record.lastActivityTimestamp is replaced with its downgrade default when it is null.
Existing non-null camera and activity timestamp values are preserved.
invariants: The migration mutates the supplied record in place.
edgeCases: When record.camera is null, it becomes { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 }.
When record.lastActivityTimestamp is null, it is restored to the migration's default timestamp value.
When either field is already non-null, that field is left unchanged.
stateMutations: The supplied record.camera property may be mutated.
